outputs.explanation: Panel A shows spatial heatmap/deconvolution plots overlaid on tissue images, not a bar chart of averages; heatmap-type plots do not require individual data points.
Panel B is a box plot with individual data points (dots) overlaid for each group/category, satisfying the requirement.
Panel C shows GSEA enrichment score line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel D is a bar graph showing log2 fold change values (derived from averaged/aggregated expression data) for multiple genes without any overlaid individual data points.
Panel E consists of H&E and IHC micrographs/photographs, not a plot of averaged data, so this check does not apply.
